# Slough App

> Slough App is a community app built for the town of Slough, UK. It connects locals through a feed, marketplace, jobs board, and groups. The app is live and free to download for iPhone on the App Store and for Android on Google Play.

Slough App is made by locals, for locals. The site at https://www.slough.app is the official website; the app itself is mobile-only and is available on the Apple App Store (https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6760595588) and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sloughapp.app).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.slough.app/): Overview of Slough App, its features, FAQs and download links.
- [Get the App](https://www.slough.app/get-slough-app/): Download links for iOS and Android.
- [About](https://www.slough.app/about/): Who is behind Slough App and why it was built.
- [Contact](https://www.slough.app/contact/): Support and contact options. General support: support@slough.app.
- Social: [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@sloughapp), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/sloughapp/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/people/Slough-App/61578994648082/).

## Slough guides

- [What's on in Slough](https://www.slough.app/guides/whats-on-in-slough/): Where events happen in Slough, things to do any week, free ideas and the town's year season by season.
- [Slough bin collection days](https://www.slough.app/guides/slough-bin-collection-days/): How to find your bin day, what goes in each bin, Christmas collection changes and waste service charges.
- [Slough school term dates](https://www.slough.app/guides/slough-school-term-dates/): Council term dates and holidays for 2026/27 and 2027/28, INSET days and admissions deadlines.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.slough.app/privacy/): How Slough App handles user data.
- [Terms of Service & EULA](https://www.slough.app/terms/): Terms of use for the app and website.
- [Child Safety Standards](https://www.slough.app/child-safety/): Slough App's standards against child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE), in line with Apple and Google requirements.
- [Accessibility](https://www.slough.app/accessibility): Which accessibility features the app supports, how to turn them on, known limitations, and how to report a problem.

## About

- Audience: Residents of Slough, Berkshire, UK and surrounding areas.
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
- Status: Live on the App Store and Google Play. Free to join and use.
- Core features: Local feed, marketplace, jobs board, groups, messaging.
